title: Anchorage contact form
description: A long enquiry form on a lifted near-black panel: a centred heading, a three-column grid of flat, square-ish fields whose labels sit inside them (selects with chevrons), two wide textareas beside a column of small square checkboxes for areas of interest, a fine-print consent line and an outlined button that fills lilac on hover. Phones stack everything in one column.
notes: plain HTML form: set action (and method) to post it anywhere; no JavaScript
labels double as placeholders, as in the original; each field still has an accessible label
name: anchorage-contact

props.name: fields
props.description: the one-line fields, three to a row on desktop

props.name: note
props.type: { label: string; name: string; link?: { label: string; href: string; }; }
props.description: the short textarea under the fields, with an optional link under it

props.name: areas
props.type: { title: string; name: string; options: string[]; }
props.description: the checkbox list beside the textareas

props.name: requiredNote
props.description: the small line explaining the required mark

props.name: consent
props.type: { text: string; name: string; small?: string; }
props.description: the consent checkbox's fine print, and an optional second line under it
